market: NO −3, total 42.5. Shough 34.5 attempts / 22.5 completions; books list Shedeur Sanders 30.5 / 18.5 for CLE. Judkins 16.5 carries; Kamara 12.5, Kendre Miller 11.5.
lineup: CLE's QB is unsettled. Deshaun Watson entered the concussion protocol Wednesday, was reported cleared Saturday, and is listed questionable; Shedeur Sanders took the work midweek. Watson has been sacked a league-high 33 times. NO RBs Travis Etienne Jr. and CJ Donaldson are out, rookie WR Jordyn Tyson is out, and LT Kelvin Banks Jr. is out.
branches: Watson starts: Harold Fannin Jr. is the volume target (26–30% share the last two weeks). Sanders starts: no NFL sample with this group, so CLE props stay off the card.

keys.take: Chris Olave, NO's first read at 27% of targets.
keys.how: CLE's pass defense has held 6 of 8 QBs under 225 yards and allows 21.6 points a game.
keys.gives: Run lanes. CLE allows 4.78 yards per carry.
keys.counter: NO's backfield is down to Kamara and Kendre Miller, so the run counter is weaker than usual.

keys.take: CLE's quick game to the TE. Fannin had 10 catches for 154 last week.
keys.how: Pressure a line that has given up 8 sacks in two of the last four games.
keys.gives: TE seams. NO allows 68.7 TE yards a game (Bowers 116, Likely 99).
keys.counter: Judkins runs at a defense allowing 5.11 yards per carry, worst of the 14 defenses here.

scripts.control: NO leads. CLE throws more, Fannin's volume rises with Watson, and Judkins drops out (11 carries for 25 in the 27–6 loss to PIT).
scripts.competitive: A grinding, low-total game (42.5). Shough's volume (39 attempts a game) meets a defense that holds QBs under 225, which caps the overs.
scripts.reversal: CLE leads behind Judkins. NO has to throw, and Olave's volume holds up even as his efficiency drops.

plays.cond: Only if Watson is active and starting, and only at 47¢ or less.
plays.why: Watson's targets have shifted to Fannin, and NO is soft against TEs.
plays.support: NO allows 9.0 TE targets and 68.7 TE yards a game. CLE has been sacked 4.1 times a game, which pushes the ball out quickly.
plays.sample: 10 and 6 catches the last two weeks on 26–30% shares. 5+ in 4 of 8 overall.
plays.counter: Only two games of the expanded role. Weeks 5–6 were 1 catch each.
plays.loses: Sanders starts, or CLE stays committed to Judkins in a close game.
plays.vs: Preferred over 45+ yards (49¢), because the catch count needs only the role to hold, not the big plays.

value: None that clears with room. The one lean depends on the QB branch.

passed.name: Tyler Shough under 225 pass yds (50¢)
passed.why: CLE held 6 of 8 under 225, but our backtest says passing-yard overs are underpriced. That leaves it at a coin flip.
passed.move: Watson out (a shorter CLE game) plus a No price of 47¢ or less.

passed.name: Chris Olave 6+ rec (54¢)
passed.why: Tyson being out helps his share, but he's caught 4, 4 and 6 in the last three games.

passed.name: Quinshon Judkins 70+ rush (47¢)
passed.why: NO allows 5.11 yards per carry, but CLE's sack-prone line kills drives, and Judkins has cleared 70 only 2 of 7 times.
passed.move: Watson starting with NO's LT out doesn't change his carries.

passed.name: Kamara / Kendre Miller
passed.why: A new split after Etienne's injury, so there's no usage to project.
passed.move: A beat report on the carry plan.

sources.t: AP via KSAT — Watson enters concussion protocol, Sanders could start (Nov 4)
